Name: Seasonal Female Bachelor Portraits and Sprites
Author: LadyoftheLight
Description:
Seasonal Portraits & Sprites inspired by assets made by Ailin, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/46420462]IronZelly[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42368125]Tanpoponoko[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2816980]Alvadea[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod of [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34618175]AdarinSinner[/url]'s[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/388] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/388]Girl Mods[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51528986]Rekooooon[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1946]Shane Girl Mod[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1936]Elliott Girl Mod[/url]﻿ I made along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33840565]RedK1rby[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7342]Female Bachelor Beach Sprite[/url]. Content Patcher version made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/46346752]jupitergirl[/url]

[b]Install:[/b] Download your preferred version and unpack into Mods folder

[size=4][b]Requirements/Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] is required
[*]This mod is technically standalone, however, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] is listed as a requirement as it is heavily referenced and maintains consistency
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url] is compatible with this mod and recommended. This mod [b]will[/b] [b]override[/b] its portraits and sprites. If you to decide to use only some of our genderswapped replacements, make sure to also edit the config of Invatorzen's mod to match (if you would like).
[/list][size=4][b]Configs[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]Seasonal Options[/b]
﻿﻿"FestivalOutfits": "[b]True[/b], False"
﻿Turns on/off festival portraits and sprites

﻿"ExtraOutfits": "[b]True[/b], False"
Turns on/off work outfits for Harvey, Sam, and Shane (Requires any of their respective "Fem" version(s) to be on)

﻿"WinterIndoorOutdoorOutfits": "[b]IndoorOutdoor[/b], IndoorOnly, OutdoorOnly"
﻿Same as the Seasonal Cute Characters config, decides if characters change clothes indoor/outdoor during winter

[b]Genderswap[/b]
﻿"Fem[Character]": "True, False"
Turns on/off the fem portraits and sprites of the character that is implemented by this mod.

[b]Alt(s)[/b]
﻿﻿"ElliottVersion": "[b]Adrarin's[/b], Rekooooon's"
Choose between Adrarin's or Rekooooon's portraits for Elliott (Requires "FemElliott" to be on)

﻿"HarveyGlasses": "[b]Red (Default)[/b], Matching (Dynamic), Pink, Orange, Yellow, Green, Teal, Blue, Purple, White, Black, Grey"
Choose the color of Harvey's glasses! The "Matching" option changes her glasses dynamically to match her current outfit. (Requires "FemHarvey" to be on)

"SamCollar": "[b]None (Default)[/b], Matching (Dynamic), Red, Pink, Orange, Yellow, Green, Teal, Blue, Purple, White, Black, Brown, Grey"
Similar to HarveyGlasses, choose the color of Sam's collar. The "Matching" option changes her collar dynamically to match her current outfit. (Requires "FemSam" to be on)

"SamCollarBell": "Gold, Silver"
Changes the bell on Sam's Collar. The "None" and "Matching" collar options will override this.

"SamHairpin": "[b]None (Default)[/b], Matching (Dynamic), Red, Pink, Orange, Yellow, Green, Teal, Blue, Purple, White, Black, Brown, Grey"
Similar to SamCollar, choose the color of Sam's hairpin. The "Matching" option changes her hairpin dynamically to match her current outfit. (Requires "FemSam" to be on)

"SamModest": "True, [b]False[/b]"
Changes Sam's Fall portrait and Moonlight Jellies portrait to be slightly more "modest" without completely changing her outfit (her shirt covers a bit more skin)
[/spoiler]
I have permission from these creators to use/edit their assets, if you want to use them you must ask them as well and check their permissions

I'm very open to critiques/suggestions for existing or possible mods, please feel free to leave them in the comments or message me!
